text:
Asha Patel: FYI — postmortem posted for the metering lag on 3/2. Root cause: delayed aggregator job + double-count on a rare retry path. Action items below, assigning owners. Please ack and call out anything missing. https://redwood.internal/pm/billing-metering-2026

Liam Chen: Ack. Can you paste the delta in token counts per-customer? need to know who to contact for invoice corrections.

Maya Ortiz: Quick snapshot I ran: most customers had <0.5% diff, four customers ~5-12% higher token counts due to the retry duplication. Pulling full list now.

Maya Ortiz: SQL I used (will paste into the doc):
```sql
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens_reported - tokens_expected) AS token_delta
FROM billing.raw_metering_events
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-02'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY token_delta DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

Tom (acct): thanks. For the four impacted customers, propose issuing invoice credit equal to the token_delta * unit_price and then a follow-up corrected invoice. I'll need invoice ids and estimated amounts by EOD.

Asha Patel: Owners/timeline:
- Maya: finish per-customer reconciliation and post CSV to the doc by EOD (owner: @Maya Ortiz).
- Liam: run a safety job to rehydrate aggregator with dedupe rules and validate on a staging slice by tomorrow morning (owner: @Liam Chen).
- Tom: prepare provisional credits and draft correction notices for the four customers, hold until reconciliation is final (owner: @Tom (acct)).
- Eng (rotation): add a monitor for retry duplication rate and alert if >0.1% per hour (owner: @Liam Chen / eng-oncall), ETA 1w.

Asha Patel: Recurrence pattern: the aggregator lag spikes around midnight UTC when batch window shifts. We should add an automatic guard to stop double-ingest during migration windows — I put that as a tech debt ticket in the postmortem.

Liam Chen: One question on credits: do we round token-based credits to nearest dollar or to cents? we should be consistent in notes.

Tom (acct): round to cents. For transparency include token math in the invoice memo and a link to the reconciliation CSV.

Maya Ortiz: Uploaded CSV to the doc: includes customer_id, invoice_id, token_delta, unit_price, credit_amount. sample rows for the 4 customers: CUST-821, INV-9941, 12400, $0.0005, $6.20; CUST-104, INV-9942, 53200, $0.0005, $26.60.

Asha Patel: Good. Next steps: Tom will draft the notices and share with legal if any contract language needed. Liam will post PR for the dedupe guard. We'll review during Monday's all-hands follow-up. Closing loop: please add status updates as replies to this thread.

billing-bot: Audit note: postmortem "billing-metering-2026" linked by Asha Patel at 1754201260.

Liam Chen: Adding a recurring 2-week postmortem check to monitor if similar gaps reappear for the next 6 weeks.

Tom (acct): I'll schedule customer outreach next Tue after reconciliation is finalized.

Maya Ortiz: Done for my items — CSV + checksums posted. Leaving open until Tom confirms credits issued.

Asha Patel: thanks all. tagging @finance for visibility :eyes:
